sources.entry: Perplexity AI - AI-powered search engine that provides comprehensive answers with sources. #freemium

summary.name: Perplexity
summary.one_liner: Perplexity is an AI-powered answer engine that aims to give accurate, sourced, real-time answers to user questions.
use_cases: asking general questions and getting sourced answers
searching the web with an AI assistant
summary.what_it_does: The page is the Perplexity homepage, showing a single prompt box ("Ask anything…") and a note that connectors can be added by typing @. Its meta description describes it as a free AI-powered answer engine that provides accurate, trusted, real-time answers to any question. A directory listing describes it as an AI search engine that gives comprehensive answers with sources. The page text itself contains little beyond the input box and a cookie notice, so specific capabilities beyond these descriptions are not confirmed here.
notable: Answers questions with sources, per directory listing
Supports connectors invoked by typing @ in the prompt box
caveats: Paid tiers are not described on this page; freemium status comes from a directory listing
